svg.title: Ausmin Deb, Data Analyst
svg.desc: A green dot leaves the i in Ausmin and becomes the data from three projects: a 60.45% default rate at 3+ late payments, 18.8% of customers driving 71% of revenue, and churn in Germany at twice other regions. It returns to the i.

g.text: ASPIRING DATA ANALYST · PYTHON · SQL · EXCEL · POWER BI
